_metadata.title: MoEFCC / Parivesh Eco-Sensitive Zones & Wetland Benchmarks (NCR & Key Metros)
_metadata.portal_name: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC) PARIVESH Portal
_metadata.disclaimer: Spatial buffer zones represent gazetted notifications under Environment (Protection) Act, 1986. Micro-level demarcation requires certified site survey.

protected_zones.name: Okhla Bird Sanctuary Eco-Sensitive Zone
protected_zones.restrictions: Prohibition of new polluting industries, high-rise restrictions within 100m, mandatory NBWL approval if within 1km buffer.
protected_zones.clearance_required: National Board for Wildlife (NBWL) NOC + State Environmental Impact Assessment Authority (SEIAA)

protected_zones.name: Surajpur Wetland & Reserve Forest
protected_zones.restrictions: Regulated construction, zero effluent discharge, groundwater extraction prohibited within 500m.
protected_zones.clearance_required: Wetland Regulatory Authority Sanction & SEIAA Clearance

protected_zones.name: Asola Bhatti Wildlife Sanctuary ESZ
protected_zones.restrictions: No commercial construction within default 1km ESZ buffer zone without Supreme Court / NBWL standing committee permission.
protected_zones.clearance_required: Supreme Court Standing Committee on NBWL Clearances

protected_zones.name: Sanjay Gandhi National Park ESZ
protected_zones.restrictions: Strict height restrictions, eco-sensitive clearance required for commercial/residential projects within buffer.

protected_zones.name: Bannerghatta National Park ESZ
protected_zones.restrictions: Regulated buffer zone prohibiting red/orange category projects, mandatory ecological buffer.
protected_zones.clearance_required: Karnataka State SEIAA & Forest Dept Clearances
